messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: ingress-5xx-spike - multiple gateways reporting 502/525 increases in eu-west-1. paging 2/2 oncall.

alex (SRE): seeing 5xx spike dashboards now, error rate up ~28% in last 3m. latencies also fattening.

maria (ingress-eng): digging into edge logs for eu-west-1. early hypothesis: TLS handshakes failing with client_hello errors.

jamal (platform): confirmed increased downstream timeouts at gateway layer, many upstream failures show "SSL routines:tls_construct_client_hello: no protocols available" and openssl handshake errors.

olivia (security): any cert rotation recently in eu-west?

maria (ingress-eng): we rotated intermediate last night for rotation job but leaf cert for gateway-eu-01 was supposed to be evergreen via acme. checking ACME logs.

alex (SRE): can we get a quick spot check from a box?

alex (SRE): ```
$ openssl s_client -connect gateway-eu-01.redwood-internal:443 -servername gateway.redwood.ai
CONNECTED(00000003)
139870123456560:error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert certificate expired:../ssl/record/rec_layer_s3.c:1547:SSL alert number 45
---
no peer certificate available
---
```

maria (ingress-eng): that error matches cert expired. looking at cert metadata now.

jamal (platform): pulling cert from the node: ```
$ sudo openssl x509 -in /etc/ssl/certs/gateway-eu-01.pem -noout -dates
notBefore=Nov 21 00:00:00 2024 GMT
notAfter=Mar 10 23:59:59 2026 GMT
```

olivia (security): confirmed expired leaf. ACME job shows a 400 from CA around 2249009000 during renew attempt. renewal failed.

zoe (customer-success): customer reports starting at ~14:22 UTC — several customers opened support tickets citing intermittent 502s. Tier-1 has triaged a few.

incident-bot: Severity escalated to P1 (customer impact) — incident incident_2249012345 created, conference bridge created: +1-800-555-0199 (pin 4321).

alex (SRE): immediate mitigation options: 1) restart gateway process to pick alternate cert if cached, 2) roll traffic away from gateway-eu-01 to gateway-eu-02, 3) hotpatch cert from last known good backup, 4) reroute region to failover region.

maria (ingress-eng): we should steer traffic first. I'm pushing an emergency traffic-steer policy to route 100% from gateway-eu-01 to gateway-eu-02. command: ```
# run from control-plane
redwoodctl route set --from gateway-eu-01 --to gateway-eu-02 --weight 100 --reason "leaf cert expired: emergency steer"
```

jamal (platform): applying now. watch connection counts and error rate.

alex (SRE): I'm opening a temporary firewall exception to allow ops to SCP cert if needed. also starting failover monitor.

maria (ingress-eng): traffic steer applied. within 30s error rate drops to baseline for eu-west-1. monitoring.

zoe (customer-success): letting impacted customers know we have an ongoing mitigation and will update with ETA for full fix.

olivia (security): we need to rotate the expired cert ASAP and investigate why ACME renewal failed. Jamal can you scp a fresh cert or approve manual statically-signed leaf?

jamal (platform): we have last-known-good cert backup on vault: /var/backups/certs/gateway-eu-01/2026-02-28.pem. I'm preparing to deploy as hotfix.

alex (SRE): quick risk call — deploying a backup cert is safe but will require gateway process reload. since traffic is steered, low risk. proceeding.

maria (ingress-eng): applied backup cert and reloaded gateway process on gateway-eu-01: ```
sudo cp /var/backups/certs/gateway-eu-01/2026-02-28.pem /etc/ssl/certs/gateway-eu-01.pem
sudo systemctl reload gateway
```

jamal (platform): health checks passing on gateway-eu-01 post reload. openssl check shows valid notAfter=Feb 28 23:59:59 2026 GMT (older) but not expired.

olivia (security): we still need to fix ACME automation. CA returned 400: rate-limited due to malformed CSR. creating a ticket to investigate and roll a fix to the renewal pipeline.

alex (SRE): initiating gradual traffic return to gateway-eu-01 (25% -> 50% -> 100%) over the next 10m while monitoring TLS handshake success.

maria (ingress-eng): 25% back -> no spike. 50% -> small blip 0.5% error increase. reverting to 25% while we watch.

jamal (platform): logs show a few ephemeral clients failing with TLSv1.2-only older clients. gateway-eu-01 backup cert supports same chain; might be client cached OCSP/staple mismatch.

alex (SRE): enabling OCSP stapling warm-up and priming cache on gateway-eu-01. command: ```
redwoodctl ocsp refresh --host gateway-eu-01
```

maria (ingress-eng): OCSP refreshed. proceeding to 50% again. stable. moving to 100%.

incident-bot: Incident incident_2249012345 update: mitigated (traffic steered then cert hotpatched). Postmortem in #postmortems, severity P1 -> ticket INC-2249.

zoe (customer-success): update sent to affected customers: apology, mitigation summary, ETA for full remediation.

olivia (security): follow-ups: 1) root cause: failed ACME renewal due to malformed CSR in pipeline; 2) short-term: improve ACME retries and alerting; 3) long-term: add secondary auto-renew path + automated canary for cert expiry 48h before.

jamal (platform): creating runbook checklist and a retrofit pipeline patch. PR created: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/4123

alex (SRE): handing off to night oncall @maria in 1h. maria, you're now incident owner for follow-up and postmortem.

maria (ingress-eng): ack. will run full certificate audit across gateways and validate automation.

zoe (customer-success): leaving a note for CS to reach back to customers after postmortem.

incident-bot: thread closed for live mitigation. last_action: traffic restored and backup cert deployed. please file postmortem and link to INC-2249.

alex (SRE): quick summary for postmortem: timeline, mitigation steps (traffic steer -> hotpatch cert -> OCSP refresh), customer impact estimate (~18% of eu-west requests for 18m window), RCA (ACME renewal malformed CSR), action items (ACME pipeline fix, 48h expiry alert, canary renewals).

maria (ingress-eng): adding logs and commands used to postmortem doc. handing to @olivia for security signoff.

olivia (security): will review and add compliance notes.

zoe (customer-success): closing loop with customers once PM review done.

alex (SRE): nice coordination everyone. incident resolved from a live-mitigation perspective; follow-ups tracked in INC-2249.
